heading: About Me
summary: Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience building scalable enterprise and e-commerce web applications using React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Skilled in designing microservices and micro-frontend architectures, crafting secure authentication pipelines, and optimizing API performance. Demonstrated success in managing full-stack project lifecycles from architecture design to production release.
body: I work across the full stack — from React and Next.js frontends to Node.js, Express and ASP.NET Core APIs — designing systems that are secure, performant, and built to scale. My focus areas include microservices and micro-frontend architecture, authentication pipelines, and API performance optimization. I manage full-stack lifecycles end-to-end, from architecture design through production release, and I mentor junior developers and interns along the way.
